about.title: About Me
about.p1: I am Luu Thang (Luu Quoc Thang), a Senior AI Engineer and Project Manager with nearly ten years in software delivery. I am at ease with both the technical and the commercial side of a project: models that must be trained and judged, and plans that must meet a budget and a date.
about.p2: I have led T&M and Fixed-Price programs, including teams of up to 20 people — planning, risk, quality, and reporting to the customer. As an engineer I design and ship production AI: LLM fine-tuning (LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT), RAG and agents, computer vision, and speech (ASR/TTS), mainly with Python and PyTorch, integrated into Java/Spring, React, and cloud services when the product needs it.
about.p3: I was previously a Technical Leader at FPT Software and a Senior Research Engineer at LG Electronics Vietnam. I still care about architecture, mentoring, and the last details that turn a demonstration into something people can trust.
about.p4: Alongside company work, I accept a limited number of independent projects for businesses: production AI, websites designed for advertising, mobile applications, and digital-transformation work that teams can run day to day. A short note is always welcome; I will reply with care.

work.title: Independent
work.lead: I am available for a limited number of independent projects: production AI, websites for advertising, mobile applications, and digital transformation for businesses. Many conversations begin through people I have already worked with. A brief message is enough; I will let you know, courteously, whether I can help.
work.aiBody: RAG and assistants over your documents, Vietnamese speech (ASR/TTS), computer vision, or fine-tuning a model for a domain task — designed, evaluated, and handed over so it can remain in production.
work.adsBody: Landing pages and sites with a clear offer, a measured load time, and a form that turns paid traffic into a conversation. Built so tracking can be attached cleanly.
work.mobileBody: iOS and Android products (React Native, or native where it is the better fit), with a defined scope, a release, and something staff or customers can use.
work.dxBody: Internal tools, process automation, and AI inside the work people already do — so the organization is not left with unused pilots or scattered spreadsheets.
work.webBody: Applications people open every day: React / Next.js, Java / Spring, or FastAPI, with authentication, data, and a release the customer can accept.
work.deliveryBody: When an AI or software workstream needs a plan, a scope, and someone accountable through acceptance — the same care I bring to T&M and Fixed-Price programs.
work.step1: You write. The problem, who it is for, the timeline, and anything you already have.
work.step2: I reply honestly. Whether I can help, or whether a narrower scope would serve you better.
work.step3: We work together. One person accountable from that conversation through a result you can use.
work.fitBody: I work well with founders, product owners, and companies that want a senior counterpart rather than a large vendor process. Conversations are confidential. I accept only as much work as I can give proper attention.

privacy.lede: Last updated: 20 September 2026. This site is operated by Luu Thang (Luu Quoc Thang), Tay Mo, Nam Tu Liem, Ha Noi, Vietnam.
privacy.collectBody: If you use the contact form, I receive the name, email, phone number (if you provide one), subject, and message you submit. The form is processed by Web3Forms and delivered to my email. Server logs on GitHub Pages may include your IP address in the ordinary course of hosting.
privacy.whyBody: I use that information only to reply to your enquiry, to discuss a possible engagement, and to keep a record of the conversation. I do not sell personal data, and I do not use it for unrelated marketing lists.
privacy.longBody: Enquiry emails are kept as long as needed to handle the request and any follow-up work, then deleted or archived with ordinary mailbox retention. You may ask me to delete your message.
privacy.choicesBody: Email thanglq.l2t@gmail.com to access, correct, or delete personal data you sent through this site.
